sentences.text: A sailing vessel under seven meters shall, if practicable, show sidelights and a sternlight.
If she doesn’t, she must have ready at hand an electric torch or lighted lantern showing a white light, exhibited in sufficient time to prevent collision.
A vessel under oars may show the sailing vessel lights, but if not, she must have that same white torch or lantern ready.
By day, a vessel proceeding under sail while also propelled by machinery shall show a cone, apex downward, forward where it can best be seen.
Inland, a vessel under twelve meters isn’t required to show this cone, but may.
